notes.title: Good News & Bad News
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, Core Romance Specialists![/h3][p]Due to some internal conflicts, our release on Steam will not be ready by August 28th. We know this is a big disappointment, but it's out of our hands. We are not sure when the Steam build will be ready.[/p][p][b]However, you WILL still be able to play the game on August 28th.[/b][/p][p]At 3:00 PM MST, we'll be opening our Itch.io page, where the game will be downloadable, playable, and fully accessible in its entirety. This page will only be accessible until the Steam release is complete, after which it will be archived for bug testing. [/p][p]I apologize greatly on behalf of me and my team - I know this is not the news you wanted to hear. We're still consistent with our release, though, so expect to see us on Itch THIS THURSDAY![/p][p][/p][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/6D9ZhZVDf6"]Discord[/url] or subscribe to our [url="https://www.youtube.com/@ApertureDatingSimulator"]YouTube[/url] to stay updated. Thank you all![/p][p][/p][p]Love,
Ashleyanna Rivers
APDS Developer[/p]

notes.title: Our release date has been announced!
notes.notes: [p]After some hard work and a lot of patience, Aperture Dating Simulator is officially ready to say... we will be releasing on [b]AUGUST 28TH, 2025[/b]! (if everything goes well)[/p][p][/p][p]Of course, like any game, we can't guarantee this is 100% accurate, but at the pace we're going, we're well on our way to being done by then. Thank you so much for your support and your patience![/p]

notes.title: WE'RE ON STEAM!
notes.notes:
Thank you, one and all, for your interest in Aperture Dating Simulator. Thanks to all the support we've had, I'm excited to announce we're finally available to wishlist! I mean, you probably already know that if you're reading this, but regardless.

This is a one-woman project (except for the voice actors, obviously) and I really appreciate all the excitement surrounding this game's eventual release. We're about halfway through our development - kind of - so we're aiming for an August or September release this year. This is, of course, subject to change.

If our achievements seem a little weird, that's normal - we're still working on those, so don't be scared. There's definitely more than just two!

Thank you once more for all the support you've given us. We're so excited to bring these characters, and this world, to life!
